simpler.evidence: Unchanged from round 1 and still holds: type word only (rejected by the Heartland run with `4Aqg23TrEDs` third, design 6, and scenario `Film rejects a season trailer`); no `series_hit` key (rejected by `Series prefers a series-marked trailer`); confidence lowering instead of rejection (design 4); `kind: Literal` (design 1); guessit dependency (Standard approach, §VII). replaced.evidence: No project-declared input is replaced and no guard dropped: `series` is a new optional caller input defaulting to prior behaviour; season profiles gain one rank key after season_hit and is_ru (season_hit stays first, guarded by `Season 1 accepts an unmarked trailer`); the film rejection only adds a relevance condition.

catcher.evidence: Risk 1 (film trailer with a marker rejected): accepted; the pick is None with the shared `no title+year match` reason, and the design states why (the caller knows it passed series=False; re-running without series separates the causes) — a deliberate trade-off, not a claimed catcher. Risk 2 (type word degrades a query for another title): accepted with 'no CI catcher' stated and the reason (golden pools bypass `_queries`, live tests cover two titles); surfacing is the consumer-visible None/foreign pick plus the per-query INFO log this package already emits (`Query union`) and the service's request/response logs. Risk 3: accepted, no catcher claimed. No named catcher is claimed that cannot reach its case.

length.evidence: `Film or series` body ~105 words, all asserted: default None (baseline scenario), season implies series (`Season profile counts as a series`), season+False ValueError (`Season contradicts a film`), each marker form alone (`Film rejects series markers`: `2 сезон`, `сериал`, `сериала` prefix form, `Series` only), the Russian and original own-title exemptions (`Film's own marker word…`, parametrized), unmarked series candidate kept (`Series keeps an unmarked trailer`), unknown unchanged (baseline). `Candidate ranking` edit (+10 words, series key position): asserted on all three sides — above cast (`Series marker outranks cast`), below Cyrillic (`Russian title outranks a series marker`), above trailer words (`Series prefers a series-marked trailer`). `Series season` edit (last sentence generalized) removes the round-1 contradiction. `Query union` edit (~30 words): asserted by `Series queries` and `Film queries`; the one unasserted case is a typed profile without a year, where 'after the year' reads as `<title> сериал trailer` — non-blocking, but the implementer should add that row to test_typed_queries so a `None` never lands in the query.

bespoke.evidence: `## Standard approach` cites guessit `type` (follows the idea without the dependency, §VII), YouTube search.list `type` (no film/series filter, so query text is the lever) and TMDB/Kinopoisk movie/tv with the consumer call site (type is an input, not a guess) — convincing. The plan adds no script or check; `title_is_series` is product code beside `_SEASON_RE`.
